verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents API capabilities an agent could call: creating nominated and unnamed cards, digital accounts with activity information, transaction processing and adjustments, and spend controls that block merchants, categories or merchant IDs. However, its official MCP server only searches endpoints and generates request code, so it does not operate the card program itself. No scoped API credentials for agents are documented; the Dashboard operator roles cover human operators, not API credentials. missing for 10: an operational MCP surface for card and balance actions, documented scoped or least-privilege API credentials, explicit card update and balance-read endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.
